description: This file defines the 'Services' class within the Thunder::Broadcast namespace, which manages DVB services, including scanning, loading, and handling service information and notifications related to DVB tuner events.

classes.name: Services
classes.description: Manages DVB services, including scanning, service list management, and handling tuner notifications.

classes.name: Services::Sink
classes.description: Implements ITuner::INotification to handle tuner activation, deactivation, and state changes.

classes.name: Services::Parser
classes.description: Handles parsing of DVB SDT sections to load service information.

classes.name: Services::Service
classes.description: Represents individual DVB service details, including service ID, name, and status flags.

methods.name: Services::Scan
methods.description: Starts or stops scanning for DVB services.

methods.name: Services::Id
methods.description: Retrieves a service by its ID.

methods.name: Services::List
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the list of loaded services.

methods.name: Services::Load
methods.description: Loads service data from a DVB SDT table.
